short_description: A modified plank on straight arms and knees that builds core and shoulder stability.
how_to: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Straighten your arms fully and lift your knees slightly off the floor.
Hold your body in one line from head to knees.
Keep your core tight and breathe steadily.
correct: Keep your body in one line.
Keep your arms straight beneath your shoulders.
mistakes: Don't let your lower back sag.
Don't lift your hips too high.

short_description: A hip-opening stretch that targets the hip flexors, glutes and outer hip.
how_to: From a tabletop position, slide one knee forward and toward your opposite hand.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Lower your hips toward the floor as far as is comfortable.
Rest your hands on the floor or fold forward and hold the position.
correct: Keep your hips square to the floor.
Keep a gentle flex in your back foot.

short_description: A supine spinal rotation that releases tension in the lower back and improves thoracic mobility.
how_to: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Let both knees fall to one side while keeping your shoulders flat.
Extend your arms out to the sides for balance.
Hold the position, then switch sides.
correct: Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.
Keep the movement gentle and controlled.
mistakes: Don't force your knees to the floor.

short_description: A chair-assisted squat or seated exercise that builds leg strength and stability.
how_to: Stand in front of a sturdy chair with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees as you lower toward the seat.
Pause just above the chair, then press through your heels to stand.
Repeat at a steady, controlled pace.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your chest up and back straight.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't rock forward onto your toes.

short_description: A chest-opening backbend that stretches the front of the body and strengthens the upper back.
how_to: Lie on your back with your legs extended and arms alongside your body.
Press your forearms into the floor and lift your chest toward the ceiling.
Tilt your head back gently and let the crown rest lightly on the floor.
Hold the position and breathe steadily.
correct: Keep your neck neutral and relaxed.
Keep your legs active and together.
mistakes: Don't press too hard on your head.

short_description: A standing yoga pose that strengthens the legs and hips while opening the chest and shoulders.
how_to: Step one foot forward into a long lunge stance.
Turn your back foot out at an angle and press it flat.
Bend your front knee to about ninety degrees.
Raise both arms overhead and hold the position.
correct: Keep your front knee over your toes.
Keep your hips square to the front.
mistakes: Don't let your front knee collapse inward.
Don't lean forward from the waist.

short_description: A kneeling backbend that stretches the front of the body and opens the chest and hip flexors.
how_to: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and your shins flat on the floor.
Place your hands on your hips and gently press your hips forward.
Reach back and place your hands on your heels one at a time.
Hold the position and breathe slowly.
correct: Keep your hips over your knees.
mistakes: Don't collapse into the pose suddenly.

short_description: A simple shoulder-mobility exercise that releases tension in the neck and upper trapezius.
how_to: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Lift both shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower your shoulders back down with control and repeat.
correct: Keep your neck long and relaxed.
Keep the movement smooth and even.

short_description: An explosive full-body jump that raises the heart rate and works the legs, glutes and shoulders.
how_to: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Bend your knees slightly, then jump and spread your legs wide.
At the same time, raise both arms out and overhead.
Land and return to the starting position, then repeat immediately.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your core braced on landing.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't lock your knees on landing.
Don't let your torso lean too far forward.

short_description: A standing leg-swing drill that loosens the hip joint and improves dynamic hip mobility.
how_to: Stand tall and hold a wall or chair for balance with one hand.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Swing it forward and back in a relaxed arc, like a pendulum.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
correct: Keep your standing leg slightly soft.
Let the leg swing freely without forcing it.
mistakes: Don't force a bigger range than feels natural.
Don't lean your torso away from the swing.

short_description: A lying core exercise that works the obliques and hip flexors by rotating the legs side to side.
how_to: Lie on your back with your arms flat on the floor to each side.
Lift your legs to a ninety-degree angle above your hips.
Lower both legs slowly to one side without touching the floor.
Bring them back to centre and lower to the other side.
correct: Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.
mistakes: Don't let your legs drop quickly.
Don't lift your shoulders off the floor.

short_description: A lying core and inner-thigh exercise that opens and closes the legs in a controlled arc.
how_to: Lie on your back with your legs raised straight above your hips.
Open both legs out wide to each side as far as comfortable.
Squeeze them back together with control.
Repeat at a steady pace.
correct: Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
Keep your legs as straight as comfortable.
Control the movement in both directions.
mistakes: Don't arch your lower back off the floor.
Don't let your legs drop too far without control.

short_description: A prone back-extension exercise that strengthens the posterior chain by pulling into a bow shape.
how_to: Lie face down with your arms at your sides.
Bend your knees and reach back to hold your ankles.
Press your feet into your hands and lift your chest and thighs off the floor.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.

short_description: A forearm plank variation that slides the body forward and back to challenge core stability.
how_to: Start in a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders.
Keeping your body rigid, shift your whole body forward a few inches.
Push back to the starting position with control.
Repeat the sawing motion at a steady pace.
correct: Keep your body in one line.
mistakes: Don't let your lower back sag.
Don't lift your hips too high.
Don't shift your weight onto your neck.

short_description: A prone core exercise that alternates leg kicks to strengthen the lower back and glutes.
how_to: Lie face down with your arms extended in front of you or resting under your forehead.
Engage your core and lift both legs slightly off the floor.
Alternate small rapid kicks up and down.
Keep your hips in contact with the floor throughout.
correct: Keep the kicks small and deliberate.

short_description: A seated forward fold that lengthens the hamstrings and releases tension in the lower back.
how_to: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you.
Sit tall and hinge forward from your hips.
Reach your hands toward your feet as far as is comfortable.
Hold where you feel a gentle stretch.
correct: Keep your back straight as you hinge.
Hinge from your hips, not your waist.
Keep a soft bend in your knees.

short_description: A seated stretch that opens the inner thighs and hips by pressing the soles of the feet together.
how_to: Sit on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together in front of you.
Hold your feet and sit up tall.
Gently press your knees toward the floor.
Hold the position and breathe slowly.
correct: Relax your inner thighs rather than forcing them down.
Hinge slightly forward from your hips to deepen the stretch.
mistakes: Don't force your knees to the floor.

short_description: A floor-based dumbbell pullover that stretches and strengthens the chest, lats and triceps.
how_to: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold one dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms above your chest.
Lower the weight slowly back over your head toward the floor.
Pull it back to the starting position with control.
correct: Keep your arms slightly bent throughout.
Keep your lower back in contact with the floor.
Breathe out as you pull back.
mistakes: Don't let the weight drop behind you.
Don't arch your lower back off the floor.

short_description: A cardio squat that combines a jumping jack with a squat to work the legs, glutes and heart.
how_to: Stand with your feet together and your arms in front.
Jump your feet out wide and drop into a squat at the same time.
Jump your feet back together as you rise to stand.
Repeat at a quick, steady rhythm.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down in the squat.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.

short_description: A plank-based cardio drill that drives each knee toward the opposite elbow to work the core and obliques.
how_to: Start in a straight-arm plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Drive your right knee toward your left elbow, rotating your hips slightly.
Return the foot and immediately drive the left knee toward the right elbow.
Alternate quickly while keeping your hips as level as possible.
correct: Keep your arms straight and stable.
mistakes: Don't let your hips rise with each step.
Don't lose the twist — reach the knee across the body each time.
